selection_provenance.selection_reason: Funding-aware dollar-neutral 30d/7d cross-sectional momentum representative; selected because the pre-specified dollar-neutral variant passed the development stability gate at 12/16/20 bps, not because it had the highest headline return.
selection_provenance.survivorship_warning: The fixed current liquid 10-coin panel is not a reconstructed point-in-time universe, so forward evidence is required before any edge claim.
selection_provenance.pre_forward_engineering_correction: Warmup fetch start expanded from 2026-07-01 to 2026-01-01 before the forward boundary because the shared MEXC history loader enforces at least 200 candles. Strategy definition, symbols, lookback, holding period, rebalance phase, costs and funding rules are unchanged.

specification.signal_rule: rank trailing_30d_close_to_close_return; long top quartile and short bottom quartile at equal dollar weights
specification.forward_rebalance_phase: first completed daily signal candle whose open timestamp is on_or_after forward_signal_start_utc, then every 7 completed daily observations
